fullDescription: Dark glassmorphic SaaS hero for an AI prompt-to-UI tool: an animated aurora field (teal #2dd4bf + magenta #e879f9 on ink #0b0f14), a frosted-glass sticky nav, a Space Grotesk headline with an aqua-to-magenta gradient accent line, two floating glass product cards (prompt + canvas output) with small feature chips, and a quiet logo trust row.
prompt:
## Resumo
A dark, glassmorphic SaaS hero for an AI prompt-to-UI design tool. Centered headline column over an animated aurora field (teal + magenta radial glows on near-black), with a frosted-glass sticky nav, a gradient duo-tone keyline in the headline, two floating glass product cards (prompt + canvas output), small floating feature chips, and a quiet logo trust row.

## Estilo Visual
Build a dark, glassmorphic hero. Background: solid ink #0b0f14 with an absolutely-positioned aurora layer made of overlapping radial gradients, aqua #2dd4bf (top-left and lower-center) and magenta #e879f9 (top-right and lower-right) plus a faint mint #a7f3eb bloom, all blurred ~38px with saturate(130%) and slowly drifting (22s ease-in-out alternate). Over it lay a faint white dot grid (radial-gradient dots, rgba(255,255,255,0.05), 40px spacing) masked to fade at the edges, and a top-and-bottom dark vignette so text stays readable. Body text color #e8eef2, antialiased. Glass surfaces: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.10), rgba(255,255,255,0.03)) fill, 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.14) border, backdrop-filter blur(22px) saturate(140%), box-shadow 0 24px 60px -24px rgba(0,0,0,0.7) plus inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.18); a lighter 'glass-soft' variant for chips. Typography: display font Space Grotesk (weights 500/600/700), body font Inter (400/500/600/700); headline weight 700, tracking tight, leading 0.98. Gradient text helper: linear-gradient(100deg, #2dd4bf 0%, #a7f3eb 30%, #f0abfc 62%, #e879f9 100%) clipped to text. Primary CTA: linear-gradient(100deg, #2dd4bf, #e879f9), ink-colored text, glow shadow 0 14px 38px -12px rgba(45,212,191,0.6); secondary CTA is a translucent white glass outline button. Use Iconify Phosphor (ph:*) icons throughout. Subtle float animation (~translateY 12px, 9-11s) on the glass cards and chips.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky glass nav
Fixed top nav inside a max-w-7xl container with side padding and top padding ~16px. The bar itself is a rounded-2xl 'nav-glass' pill: background rgba(13,18,24,0.55), 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.10) border, backdrop-blur(18px) saturate(140%). Left: a gradient (aqua to magenta) rounded-lg square holding a ph:sparkle-fill ink-colored icon, next to the wordmark 'Lumina' in Space Grotesk 700. Center (md+ only): text links Library, Canvas, Skill, Pricing in white/65, with hover white + white/5 background. Right: a 'Sign in' ghost link (sm+ only) and a gradient 'Start free' pill button (ink text).

### Hero headline column
Centered max-w-3xl text column with top padding ~144px. Start with a glass-soft rounded-full eyebrow pill: a small gradient 'NEW' tag (uppercase, ph:lightning-fill) + label 'Prompt-to-UI on an infinite canvas' in white/75 + a trailing ph:arrow-right in white/45. Headline in Space Grotesk 700, tracking tight, leading 0.98, sized clamp-style (~2.75rem mobile to 7xl desktop): 'Ship interfaces at' on line one, then a gradient duo-tone line 'the speed of thought' (aqua to magenta text clip). Subhead paragraph max-w-xl, white/70, ~base/lg: 'Describe the screen you want. Lumina generates production-ready mockups, components, and full flows on a living canvas, then hands them straight to your coding agent.'

### CTA row + social proof
Below the subhead, a button row (column on mobile, row centered on sm+): primary gradient pill 'Start designing free' with ph:magic-wand-fill ink icon; secondary translucent white glass-outline button 'Watch the demo' with an aqua ph:play-circle-fill icon. Under the buttons, a small centered social-proof row: three overlapping circular avatar dots filled with aqua-to-magenta gradients (ring in ink color), followed by 'Loved by 57,000+ builders & design teams' in white/70 text-xs.

### Floating glass cards cluster
A max-w-5xl 12-col grid (single column on mobile) sitting ~64-80px below the headline, with a localized blurred aurora glow behind it so the glass refracts light. Left card (md:col-span-7, glass, rounded-3xl, float animation): header with an aqua-tinted rounded icon (ph:chat-circle-text-fill) + 'Prompt' label and three small status dots (last one aqua). Inside, a dark inset rounded-2xl prompt block: a monospace-feeling line '> a pricing page for a SaaS analytics tool, three tiers, dark mode, glassy cards, with a monthly/annual toggle' (the '>' in aqua), a hairline divider, then pill tags '3 tiers' (aqua), 'glassmorphism' (magenta), 'dark' (white), and a right-aligned pulsing-dot 'generating' status. Right card (md:col-span-5, glass, rounded-3xl, float animation, opposite phase): header with a magenta-tinted icon (ph:squares-four-fill) + 'Canvas output'; a 2-col stat grid ('12s' gradient text / 'avg. first draft', '4' / 'variants / run'); a hairline; then a checklist of three ph:check-circle-fill rows ('Responsive across breakpoints', 'Editable layers, real tokens', 'Export to code in one click', last check in magenta).

### Floating feature chips
Two small glass-soft rounded-2xl chips absolutely positioned over the card cluster, visible on lg+ only, each with a float animation. Top-right chip: a gradient rounded-xl ph:cursor-click-fill icon + 'Infinite canvas' / 'drag, fork, remix'. Bottom-left chip: a magenta-tinted rounded-xl ph:terminal-window-fill icon + 'Works in your agent' / 'Claude Code · Cursor'.

### Trust logo row
Below the cards (~80-96px), a centered trust row: a small uppercase wide-tracked label 'Trusted in the workflows of teams at' in white/60, then a flex-wrapped row of five fictional logos in white/65, each a Space Grotesk 600 wordmark with a leading Phosphor glyph: ph:cube-fill Northwind, ph:circles-three-fill Helio, ph:hexagon-fill Vantage, ph:triangle-fill Apex, ph:diamond-fill Lattice.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Componente
Animated aurora background: overlapping radial-gradient blooms (aqua #2dd4bf + magenta #e879f9 + mint #a7f3eb) blurred 38px / saturate(130%), drifting on a 22s ease-in-out alternate keyframe, capped by a dark top/bottom vignette.

### Componente
Masked dot-grid overlay: radial-gradient dots rgba(255,255,255,0.05) at 40px spacing, radial-masked to fade out toward edges, for subtle depth.

### Componente
Glassmorphism surface system: a heavy 'glass' (blur 22px, saturate 140%, inner top highlight + deep drop shadow), a lighter 'glass-soft' for chips, and a 'nav-glass' for the sticky bar.

### Componente
Gradient duo-tone text fill: linear-gradient(100deg, #2dd4bf, #a7f3eb, #f0abfc, #e879f9) clipped to the headline accent line and stat numbers.

### Componente
Gradient glow CTA: aqua-to-magenta pill with a colored, two-tone glow drop shadow; hover brightens.

### Componente
Floating cards/chips: gentle translateY float (9-11s, offset delays) on the product cards and feature chips.

### Componente
Iconify Phosphor (ph:*) icon set used for every glyph (nav mark, eyebrow, CTAs, card headers, checklist, trust-row logos).

## Notas Especiais
Colors are an exact 3-color system: ink #0b0f14 (canvas), aqua #2dd4bf, magenta #e879f9, plus mint stops #a7f3eb / #f0abfc in gradients and body text #e8eef2. Fonts: Space Grotesk (display/headings, 500-700) + Inter (body, 400-700) via Google Fonts. Glass legibility depends on the dark vignette over the aurora, keep it. Honor the responsive reflow: hide md-only nav links and lg-only floating chips on small screens, stack the two cards and the CTA row, and scale the headline down to ~2.75rem on mobile. Built with Tailwind (CDN) + Iconify; no real photography, the visual interest is entirely gradient + glass + type.
